text: Three disgusting addictions stopping you from building your dream physique.
90% of people around you are out of shape.
Saying yes to that habits is saying yes to that version of you who is okay with having that body.
You blame your genetics, family, and circumstances.
I have had type one diabetes since I was a child, but that didn't stop me from looking like this.
Two thousand years ago, Seneca wrote, "If you don't know which harbor you are sailing for, no wind is favorable.
And then luck has power over our lives because we live by luck." Just pick a harbor and stop waiting for the wind.
Seneca said, "Why would I be scared of my mistakes when I can just say, 'I forgive you this time.
You can't fix your body if you can't look at it.
When you hate yourself, you stop stepping on the scale and stop tracking what you eat.
When you forgive yourself, you can look at your flaws, own it, and fix it
